open_points.subject: A13 guard evaluation
open_points.text: "A guarded edge delivers only when its guard port's value equals its guard value."
open_points.question: What exact equality semantics must be used for guard comparison at run time (e.g., numeric form differences, object key order, array deep equality)?
options: Compare by language-native structural equality after JSON parse
Compare by canonical JSON byte equality (RFC 8785)
Restrict guardable schemas so equality is only scalar literal equality
open_points.default_guess: Compare by canonical JSON equality to stay deterministic across runtimes.

open_points.subject: A09/A10 request headers
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 rejects required headers only when the instance "names one required header twice"; A10 rule 7 says sent headers are exactly host + required headers + credential header (+ content headers).
open_points.question: If required_headers contains a name that collides with implicit protocol headers (host/content-type/content-length/accept-encoding) or credential header, should proposal be refused, overridden, or sent with duplicates?
options: Refuse proposal/acceptance on any collision with implicit or credential headers
Allow collision and let required_headers override implicit header values
Allow duplicates on wire in fixed order and include all in request_digest
open_points.default_guess: Refuse on collision to avoid ambiguous wire requests and approval digests.

open_points.subject: A03 trap telemetry channel
open_points.text: "Each trap, before raising, writes its hit to the runner's channel to the parent, which user code cannot unsend; any recorded hit makes the execution sandbox_violation..."
open_points.question: What is the required behavior if writing the trap hit to the parent channel itself fails (channel full/broken/process crash) after a prohibited call occurred?
options: Treat as sandbox_violation anyway based on local trap event
Treat as crashed because violation evidence was not delivered
Abort sandbox process and classify as crashed with dedicated detail
open_points.default_guess: Classify as sandbox_violation based on local trap event, independent of channel delivery success.
